## Step 1: Is this the extension, or is it monmux?

This repository is **only** the GNOME Shell extension. Questions about what `monmux` does, which monitors it supports, why it
refused something, or how to run it from a terminal belong to [leinardi/monmux](https://github.com/leinardi/monmux).

| Question | Where it belongs |
| --- | --- |
| Installing, enabling, or updating the extension | here |
| What the menu shows, why an entry looks the way it does, what a notification meant | here |
| Preferences, shortcuts, GNOME Shell version support | here |
| Whether monmux supports a monitor, and how to get one supported | [monmux](https://github.com/leinardi/monmux/issues/new/choose) |
| Why monmux refused a switch, or what an exit code or refusal reason means | [monmux](https://github.com/leinardi/monmux/issues/new/choose) |
| Installing or configuring monmux, ddcutil or m1ddc | [monmux](https://github.com/leinardi/monmux/issues/new/choose) |

* [ ] My question is about the extension, not about what monmux decides or how to run it.
* [ ] I have checked the existing issues and discussions to see if this has already been answered.
